{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for SEVERE disease at baseline
severe_patients = df[df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Define sentinel value
sentinel_value = -999.0

# Exclude rows with sentinel value in baseline biomarker
valid_severe = severe_patients[severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'] != sentinel_value]

# Compute mean baseline biomarker value for SEVERE patients with valid biomarker values
mean_biomarker_severe = valid_severe['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Output the result
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value for SEVERE patients (excluding sentinel values): {mean_biomarker_severe}")"}
